sources.rat: DANDI 000978 (Shin & Jadhav), streamed: position, trials, units (spike times, CA1/PFC); 9 sessions / 8 rats
sources.human: Zenodo 8058006 (Seger, Lega & Ekstrom 2023), md5 1af121e6618477bceea09354cedc4f8e; 11 patients, 87 hippocampal-area electrodes

networks: frozen ('human_bc', 'rat_bc', 'human_legal_uniform', 'cold_ppo') and learned ('ppo', 'bl3', 'bl7') (from human_bc), seeds 1000-1029; no training
replay: recorded trials replayed with the environment's own sensing (frame, flags, last move, LogBelief); no goal termination; 45-move episodes
conditions: rats (cell, heading), humans cell (heading pooled; ~39 trials), each with >= 4 visits with neural data in each of odd / even trials; sessions with < 8 conditions excluded; sessions averaged within subject

neural.rat: unit rates in each cell visit (>= 50 ms), units with mean > 0.1 Hz; groups all / CA1 / PFC
neural.human: log Hilbert power in ((2, 4), (4, 8), (8, 12), (12, 30), (30, 70), (70, 110)) Hz, z per electrode; all electrodes

rdm: 1 - Pearson (hidden, image, text, pixels, neural); Euclidean (action probabilities); space = track distance, heading change
outcomes: descriptive: per subject Spearman rho(model, neural), partial (space, heading, pixels); mean over subjects, t CI; split-half ceiling (Spearman-Brown); label permutation; next-move probability on the same states; families = frozen priors, ppo, bl3, bl7
role: addition to the camera-ready; the paper's registered claims are unchanged
outcomes_seen: none; check printed trial / condition counts and the belief-on-true-cell rate only
deviations_allowed: none; any fix after this file goes to an ADDENDUM
